correctness.rationale: The support-by-parts classification is exhaustive: with no label 2, all vertices must be 1; with label 2 in at least two parts every 0 has an external 2-neighbor; with label 2 in exactly one part, precisely that part must contain no 0. The generating formula counts these disjoint cases, and exhaustive replay through order 10 matches every coefficient and minimum-weight corollary.

value.rationale: The result gives a natural complete classification and exact weight enumerator for all Roman dominating functions on every connected complete multipartite graph.
